description: Add tags (by name) to a task you can access, or remove them with remove: true, after the user approved it. Names match existing tags ignoring case, spaces, '-', '_' and '.', so a quickly typed 'frontEnd' reuses 'Frontend'. An unknown name is created as a new tag, unless it looks like a typo of an existing tag: then nothing changes and the error names that tag, so ask the user. Returns per name added, alreadyPresent, removed or notPresent (isNewTag when the tag was created) and the task's tags; repeating the call is harmless.

remove.description: true removes the tags from the task instead of adding them; never creates tags. Default false.

tags.description: Tag names. Matched to existing tags ignoring case, spaces, '-', '_' and '.' (Frontend = frontEnd = front-end). An unknown name is created as a new tag, unless it looks like a typo of an existing tag: then nothing changes and the error names the existing tag.

name: laviya_update_task_tags
title: Update Task Tags
